children: Hungary's industrial output (HUIND=ECI) rose by an annual 4.7% in July based on preliminary unadjusted data, above analyst forecasts for a 3.2% increase, the Central Statistics Office (KSH) said on Monday.
In June industrial output rose by 10.1%.
Adjusted for the effect of working days, output grew by 4.7% year-on-year, while in monthly terms, it increased by 1.7%, the KSH said.
